row.title: A helper that throws on any non-ok status breaks callers that branch on status
row.body: PR 1851 made the sweeper's gh() throw on non-ok; every caller branched on 410/405/409, so one disabled-issues 410 aborted a repo's sweep. gh() returns status again; callers record errors.
row.probe: grep:seed/worker/src/sweeper.js::Not a throw: every caller reads ok/status
